outcome: Coagulation function (reaction time R, K, a, coagulation index CI)
Platelet contribution to clot strength (maximum amplitude MA, Gp)
cohort: The study included 15 patients scheduled to undergo TAVI for severe aortic stenosis.
finding: Compared with the preoperative period, coagulation tended to increase, and platelet contribution to clot strength decreased from days 1 to 3 after TAVI.
